data.name: Miskeen
data.gender_notes: Miskeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Miskeen refers to someone who is poor, needy, or humble. In Islamic context, it signifies a person who is humble and dependent on Allah. The name Miskeen carries the meaning “Poor, Needy, Humble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Miskeen usually hope their child will grow to embody poor, needy, humble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, 'Miskeen' is used to describe those who are poor and needy, and are entitled to receive charity (Zakat).
data.etymology: Miskeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Poor, Needy, Humble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miskeen total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مسكين
in_arabic.long_meaning: المسكين هو الشخص الذي يتصف بالفقر والحاجة، وغالبًا ما يستخدم لوصف من يملك القليل من المال أو السلطة، وفي القرآن الكريم، يأتي هذا المصطلح ليشير إلى عباد الرحمن الذين يمشون على التواضع والسكينة.

in_urdu.name: مiskin
in_urdu.long_meaning: مسکین وہ شخص ہوتا ہے جو مالی یا معاشرتی طور پر کمزور ہوتا ہے، اور اکثر اس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے کہ وہ شخص تواضع اور فروتنی کے ساتھ جیتا ہے، اسلامی تقالید میں مسکین کو ایک ایسا شخص سمجھا جاتا ہے جو اپنی کمزوریوں کے باوجود اللہ پر بھروسہ کرتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: मिस्कीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिस्कीन वह व्यक्ति है जो आर्थिक या सामाजिक रूप से कमजोर होता है, और अक्सर इसका अर्थ होता है कि वह व्यक्ति नम्रता और सादगी के साथ जीवन जीता है, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में मिस्कीन को एक ऐसा व्यक्ति माना जाता है जो अपनी कमजोरियों के बावजूद अल्लाह पर भरोसा करता है.

in_pashto.name: مسکین
in_pashto.long_meaning: مسکین هغه څوک دی چې اقتصادي یا ټولنیز ډول کمزوری وي، او ډیری وخت دا پدې معنی دی چې هغه څوک په تواضع او سوله کې ژوند کوي، د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مسکین یو داسې څوک ګڼل کیږي چې د خپلو کمزوریو سره سره پر الله باندې باور ولري.

in_english.name: Miskeen
in_english.long_meaning: Miskeen is derived from the Arabic root 'masakana', meaning to be poor or weak, it refers to a person who is economically or socially weak, often connoting a sense of humility and modesty, in Islamic tradition, Miskeen is associated with the righteous servants of the Most Merciful, who walk on earth in humility and sedateness.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic societies, the term Miskeen is often used to describe someone who is in need of help or someone who is suffering from poverty, sickness, or hardship. The culture values providing help and support to the Miskeen as a means of demonstrating compassion and following the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who said, "I and the person who takes care of the needy, will enter Paradise together."
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the term Miskeen holds deeper meaning as it reminds Muslims of the importance of compassion, empathy, and humility towards fellow human beings. In the Quran, Allah says, "We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on land and sea and provided for them sustenance and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [defense] in this world and in the Hereafter. And [this is] a favor from Us and a reminder to them of the blessing of Allah upon them" (Ar-Rahman, 55:5-6). By recognizing our own dependence on Allah and the needs of others, we can strive to become better Amans, or believers, through acts of kindness, charity, and humility towards the Miskeen.
